verses.text: For the music director. On an instrument from Gath. A psalm of the sons of Korah. How lovely is the place where you live, LORD of Armies!
I long and even faint with longing for the courtyards of the LORD. My heart and my whole body cry out for the living God.
Even the sparrow has found a home, and the swallow has a nest for herself where she can have her young, near your altars, LORD of Armies, my King and my God.
Happy are those who live in your house. They are always praising you. Selah.
Happy are those whose strength comes from you, whose hearts are set on travelling to your house.
As they pass through the Valley of Tears, they make it a place of springs. The autumn rains cover it with pools of blessing.
They grow stronger and stronger, and each of them appears in front of God in Zion.
LORD God of Armies, hear my prayer. Listen, God of Jacob. Selah.
God, our shield, look with kindness on the face of your anointed king.
One day in your courtyards is better than a thousand days anywhere else. I would rather stand at the door of the house of my God than live in the tents of the wicked.
The LORD God is our sun and our shield. The LORD gives kindness and honour. He does not hold back any good thing from those who live blameless lives.
LORD of Armies, happy is the person who trusts in you.
